status.label: Out
status.shortComment: Beck (back) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Kansas City, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.
status.longComment: The Cardinals were already preparing for Josh Johnson to operate as the starting quarterback Sunday, as Beck entered the weekend with the questionable tag due to back spasms. Joey Aguilar will operate as Johnson's backup, and Beck's next opportunity to play is Week 12 against the Commanders on Sunday, Nov. 29.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: Minshew (elbow) underwent UCL reconstructive surgery Monday, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.
status.longComment: Though the procedure will bring an end to Minshew's season, he's expected to make a full recovery ahead of the 2027 campaign. The veteran quarterback sustained the injury while making his lone start of the season Week 9 in Seattle, but he played though the elbow issue and completed 21 of 30 passes for 166 yards. Rookie third-round pick Carson Beck took over as the Cardinals' starting quarterback in Week 10 and is expected to lead the offense for the remainder of the season.

status.label: Out
status.shortComment: Gaines (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
status.longComment: Gaines will miss a fourth consecutive game while recovering from an ankle injury, and his next opportunity to play is Week 12 against the Commanders on Sunday, Nov. 29. Hjalte Froholdt has cleared the league's concussion protocol and is slated to start at center against Kansas City.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The Cardinals placed Burch (knee) on injured reserve Tuesday.
status.longComment: This move was a foregone conclusion, as head coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that Burch will miss the remainder of the campaign after suffering an MCL injury to his left knee. The defensive end finished his sophomore NFL season with 19 tackles, including 1.0 sacks, over 10 games. Burch will now look to get healthy in the hope of being ready for the 2027 campaign.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: Carter (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Zach Gershman of the Cardinals' official site reports.
status.longComment: Carter opened the regular season on injured reserve due to a knee injury he picked up in training camp in early August. He logged a trio of full practices during Week 11 prep but is not quite ready to return, so his next chance to make his 2026 debut is Week 12 against the Commanders on Sunday, Nov. 29.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: Wingard (wrist) was placed on injured reserve by the Cardinals on Tuesday.
status.longComment: Wingard picked up a wrist injury in the team's 34-6 loss to the Rams in Week 10, and he will now be forced to miss at least four contests while recovering from the injury. In Wingard's absence, Kitan Crawford and Dadrion Taylor-Demerson are both candidates to replace him as the team's starting free safety Sunday versus the Chiefs.
